verdict.rationale: Lever's own AI features page says 'AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries' automatically capture interview conversations and generate recaps for hiring managers. That covers the recording, transcription and summary core. Nothing shows the summaries flowing into the scorecard or how candidate consent for recording is handled, and the evidence is a single marketing claim. Missing for 10: summaries distilled into scorecards, candidate recording-consent handling, in-depth product docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries automatically capture conversations and generate actionable recaps, helping recruiters and hiring managers stay focused, speed up feedback, and make decisions faster.
